body:
> horrible for performance

If the user has to resort to using TIME in their shader it's the same.

> guarantees worst-case performance

Why choose real-time if you're not updating every frame? That sounds niche to me, especially when quality mode exists. The user can address performance by switching to quality mode when their background is static.

> not something we want to force on users

I agree that the better solution is for ViewportTexture to trigger the update automatically. The problem is that ViewportTexture has proven unreliable, and it's the cause of much confusion and wasted time. People need a sure-fire way of triggering an update that isn't a hack. Performance can wait.
